title: FERC Section 7 Gas Certificate
permit_name: Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity

source_citations.reference: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Natural Gas Pipelines

permits.name: Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity

explanations.trigger_explanation: New or expanded interstate natural gas pipeline facilities commonly require Federal Energy Regulatory Commission authorization under Section 7 of the Natural Gas Act.

known_unknowns: Some limited facility work may be handled under blanket certificate authority rather than a full case-specific certificate filing.
advisories: Additional review recommended to confirm whether the facility is interstate and whether blanket certificate provisions could apply.
notes: Confidence tier 1 because Federal Energy Regulatory Commission authority and its implementing regulations are directly cited; this rule is intentionally limited to interstate natural gas facilities.
